rows.name: Product Safety Database annual report 2025 to 2026 release announcement
rows.publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards
rows.semantic_limit: A release announcement contains no final statistical results and must not be treated as evidence of product prevalence, geographic exposure or parcel risk.
rows.evidence_basis: The official announcement describes the planned Product Safety Database annual report and confirms a release date of 27 August 2026.

rows.name: RAIB investigation reports, safety digests and urgent safety advice 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Investigation reports and urgent advice concern defined occurrences and safety learning; they cannot be generalized into a deterministic risk score for every nearby property or trackside parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official 2026 register lists RAIB reports, safety digests, discontinuation reports and urgent safety advice, including a report published on 28 July 2026.

rows.name: Industry Safety Steering Group fifth building-safety report
rows.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
rows.semantic_limit: Sector culture, governance and best-practice findings are system-level context; they do not certify the compliance or physical safety of a named building or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official independent report reviews built-environment safety culture, industry progress, blockages and actions to support safer practice.

rows.name: Fire and rescue incident statistics year ending June 2026 release announcement
rows.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
rows.semantic_limit: The announcement provides scope and a future publication date but no final incident results; it cannot update fire-risk calibration before release.
rows.evidence_basis: The official announcement states that the accredited statistics will cover incidents, fires, casualties and response times and are scheduled for 28 October 2026.

rows.name: Future of Rural England Report safe communities section
rows.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
rows.semantic_limit: National policy themes and stakeholder outcomes for safe rural communities are contextual and cannot substitute for measured local crime, emergency-response or parcel-level evidence.
rows.evidence_basis: The official report includes a safe-communities chapter alongside rural infrastructure, health, housing and connectivity themes.

rows.name: How CQC regulates and takes action
rows.semantic_limit: Regulatory process guidance explains evidence gathering, inspection, publication and enforcement; it is not itself an assessment of any provider, service user or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official CQC page describes registration, monitoring, evidence use, expert inspection, ratings publication and enforcement action.
